resources.string: Zero ads, zero Shorts, Study & Relax environments, plus Creator Mode with Outlier Badges, YouTube Studio, and a zero-API-key Gemini AI workbench.
Know someone who needs a website or custom software? Earn 10% on every closed project.
Distraction-free YouTube + Creator Mode with Outlier Badges, YouTube Studio, and 1-click Gemini AI tools—built by Studio Mogli.
1. Your Google & Gemini Accounts Stay Strictly Private
Sign-in happens directly on Google\'s official login page. Studio Mogli never sees, touches, or stores your credentials or API keys.
2. Zero Backend Servers, Zero Data Collection
All environments, channel lists, timers, and AI prompts run strictly on your device. No analytics SDKs or hidden permissions.
Tap the top-left pill to cycle Study (Whitelist), Relax (Blacklist + Timer), and Creator (YouTube Studio + Outlier Badges + 1-click Gemini Drawer).
